messages.subject: Constraints on the linear predictor
parts:
Dear all,

I can define sum-to-zero constraints for sets of the linear predictor using the `cross` option in `control.predictor`. 

Is there a way to define more general cross-constraints for linear predictors? Something like …

inv.link(linear.predictor[1]) + 2 * inv.link(linear.predictor[2]) + inv.link(linear.predictor[3]) ^ 2 = 5 


Thank you,

Martin Zuba

messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Constraints on the linear predictor
parts:
No. Nonlinear constraints are not implemented. 

D
